title: Margin Dynamics for Large Language Model Alignment
abstract: arXiv:2611.21766v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Practitioners choose among LLM alignment methods largely by trial and error. We provide a theoretical foundation: each pairwise method defines a vector field on the probability simplex that governs how the model redistributes mass between preferred and dispreferred completions. Projecting onto a single preferred/dispreferred pair reduces this to a one-dimensional margin ODE with a closed-form solution. These solutions reveal that DPO margins grow without bound (logarithmically as $O(\log t)$ in the gradient-flow limit) while IPO margins converge to a finite $1/(2\tau)$; that label noise induces a qualitative phase transition in DPO (unbounded $\to$ bounded) but affects IPO only quantitatively; and that gradient concentration under asymmetric weighting governs trainability at scale. translated_title: 大语言模型对齐的间隔动力学
translated_abstract: 实践者目前主要依靠反复试错来选择大语言模型对齐方法。我们为其提供了理论基础：每种成对比较方法都在概率单纯形上定义了一个向量场，用以支配模型在偏好与非偏好补全之间如何重新分配概率质量。将该问题投影到单个偏好/非偏好补全对上，可简化为一维的间隔常微分方程，且具有闭式解。这些解揭示了：DPO 的间隔会无界增长（在梯度流极限下按 $O(\log t)$ 对数级增长），而 IPO 的间隔则收敛到有限的 $1/(2\tau)$；标签噪声会使 DPO 发生定性相变（从无界变为有界），但对 IPO 只有定量层面的影响；非对称加权下的梯度集中决定了大规模训练时的可训练性。我们在涵盖四个基准测试的五个模型家族上验证了上述全部三项预测。闭式解还使有原则的方法设计成为可能：我们……
tldr: 本文通过对齐方法在概率单纯形上的向量场建模并求解一维间隔常微分方程的闭式解，首次从理论上揭示 DPO 间隔无界增长而 IPO 间隔收敛于有限值的本质差异，并预测了标签噪声导致 DPO 定性相变及非对称加权下梯度集中对可训练性的影响，在五个模型家族和四个基准上得到验证。
en_tdlr: This paper derives closed-form solutions to one-dimensional margin ODEs from vector-field models of pairwise alignment methods on the probability simplex, theoretically revealing that DPO margins grow unboundedly while IPO margins converge to a finite limit, and predicting a qualitative phase transition of DPO under label noise, with all predictions validated across five model families and four benchmarks.
